why: No test records what leaves the phone for the update check, watch checks, What's new or charts; updatePrompt.test.ts:37-70 tests only timing rules. The code itself makes no member-data call (updateStore.ts:39 only opens the Play page), so this is a test gap with low real risk.

No test or QA flow holds 'Nothing to back up yet' or 'Couldn't save the backup' (grep of test/ and qa/ finds none). Partly softened: backupCoverage.test.ts:29-35 forces every saved key to be carried or listed left-out, and backupCoverage.ts:29,74-91 lists the gym key, gym link and AI keys as left out, but no test opens a real file from a gym-joined phone and looks for them.

The page IS opened and photographed (qa/redesign-r.yaml:724-736 finds 'Mobile number, optional' and Body figure), so the group title 'never used' overstates it; but no test or flow taps a chip, sees 'Saved', removes the number to see 'Number removed'/Undo (ProfileCard.tsx:445) or fails a save; profileAutosave.test.ts tests only the rules.

Partly overstated: the access rule is tested (memberPlanRules.test.ts:47 lists weightSuggestions as paid; :98-107 a gym member on a running plan gets every feature). But nothing tests the place it bites, targetStore.ts:141 (canUseNow('weightSuggestions') blanks targets), and the Plus device flow checks only charts (uat-rel-r461-plus.yaml:109-138).

The cards are set to show in full on a locked phone (RestCard.kt:842 setVisibility VISIBILITY_PUBLIC, channels at :1236-1383 lockscreenVisibility PUBLIC), yet no test greps or checks that setting or the card text; tests only check setLocalOnly (liveCard.test.ts:111, watchBridge.test.ts:57).

No flow or test holds 'Nothing opened?' or 'not available on this phone', presses Stop/Not now or double-taps send; HC_STOPPED is checked only as a sentence (healthR267.test.ts:291-296). The 'lands once' risk is low in code: Health.kt:329 writes with clientRecordId 'forgeai-<id>', which Health Connect replaces rather than duplicates, though no test checks that line.

No test or flow holds 'Looking for your gym', 'Send the message in WhatsApp', 'we never message you' or 'You train there on a pass.'; the device flow uses a made-up answer that skips the wait (uat-rel-f203-phone-sign-in.yaml:5-7) and phoneSignIn.test.ts has no back-out or late-answer case.

The words exist in DataCard.tsx:109 ('Could not remove the demo. Nothing was changed.'), :228 ('Removingâ€¦') and :230 (the sample-member caption), but no test or QA flow holds any of them; uat-d.yaml:100-117 opens the sheet only from Settings and never cancels or fails it, and the tab-bar Remove (TrackerTabBar.tsx:199) is never tapped.

welcomeResume.test.ts:6-27 only packs and unpacks the text; uat-e.yaml:108-180 has no stopApp/launchApp mid-setup, and no test checks the mark is cleared after the profile is made or kept after a failed Start training (WelcomeScreen.tsx wires it, untested).

True at screen level but softer than stated: the shared double-tap guard runGuarded IS unit-tested (loadState.test.ts:67-82: second tap returns 'busy', guard released after failure) and the Workout tab uses it (workout.tsx:319,333); no test drives the tab itself or checks START_FAILED ('Couldn't start the workout. Try again.', guardedAction.ts:41) or that a failed start leaves nothing half made.

The warnings exist (library/new.tsx:256 'video is too large', :317 'Already in your library', :372 'Saved, but not added'; hidden.tsx:78 'Nothing hidden') and a grep of test/ and qa/ finds none of them, so no test reads any.

No test checks a routine file for name, body weight or history (routinesHevyReal.test.ts:283-326 checks only round-trip size and re-import). Low real risk: the file is built from kind, version, folder and routines only (routineFile.ts:73-75 via plansService.ts:128), so there is no profile field to leak; the gap is the missing guard test.

The lead claim is wrong: qa/uat-h.yaml:376-440 (run as part UH, run-device-qa.sh:1593) taps 'Delete workout', sees 'Delete this workout?', presses Delete and checks the day and month count on Calendar and the Profile count go back. What is really untested is smaller: Records after a delete, 'Workout not found' (session/[id].tsx:211), a failed read or delete, the one-set line and the fourth-photo limit.

Two of three parts hold: no flow or test holds 'No diet plan yet' (DietPlanScreen.tsx:85) or 'Take back my question' (askTrainer.ts:77). The news part is wrong: qa/xj-3-bell.yaml:10-23 (run by run-journeys.sh:246) and qa/invite-e.yaml:42-50 open 'Messages from your gym' on a device and read the message.

No QA flow holds the card title 'Make your first routine' or any step title ('Name your folder', 'Pick your exercises', 'Check and save'; firstRoutine.ts:123-143); the only 'first routine' hits in qa/ mean a plan's first day. firstRoutine.test.ts tests only the rules and words.
